The observed historical blocker was named .claude/wache-befehl.py. Its identity/equivalence to archived wache-koenig.py is unresolved and must not be inferred from lineage or naming.

For Frankenstein 2.0 R2/R3 recursive harness execution, child safety/effect policy must not depend solely on cwd-local hooks.
